x: It was very encouraging to see John Moore once again out on the road and approaching something like his old fitness. Also out that day were Norman Stairs, Ray Conway,and Charlie Manning. We congratulate all concerned on a profitable Bank Holiday's running.

The race was organised by Ray Conway, his first ever promotion, and it was a tribute to his fine work that a prominent Midland official should make an impromptu speech congratulating Belgrave on their excellent organisation.

Eric Gebbett (A) Jack Brown (B) and Ray Conway (C) set off on the first stage and eyebrows were raised when Jack and Eric came down the finishing straight together in 6th and 7th positions - a fine start for both teams.

Thanks, once again, to Ray Conway the organisation went off extremely well. The able assistance of Arthur Whitehead, of Denis Brickwood and his results team, and of the many officials, was invaluable.

There seems no end to the various methods used nowadays to relieve the boredom of training or obtain that little extra performance. We have it, on good authority, that Ray Conway has taken up 'chasing butterflies' whilst Bill Dance eats rhubarb to improve his running !
Our two Honorary Auditors Ray Conway and Ken Miller have served the Club loyally for many years and feel that it is time to ease someone else into their shoes.
Auditors Ray Conway and Ken Miller, who between them seem to have put in so many years that it can't be true, were elected Life Members of Belgrave Harriers.

He has been away from the innermost affairs of the "Bels" for a while, but is back now, not only for the dinner-dance, but also as a new auditor of the Club, taking over from Ray Conway, another long servant.
